results.title: Tell an API outage apart from a missing page (today an outage renders a 404)
results.author: QueenGiba
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `apiGet` in `apps/web/src/lib/api.ts` returns `null` for every failure: a 404, a 500, a timeout, DNS failure, invalid JSON. results.title: A purchase of an asset paid with BTC from the Bitcoin ark never completes
results.body_snippet: **What goes wrong.** In default mode a wallet's BTC sits on the Bitcoin ark, so a purchase of an asset with BTC is paid from the ark. results.author: tine1117
